# MatchMetadata { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchMetadata }

```python
alignment.MatchMetadata()
```

Provenance information for a match claim.

A match claim records who authored it and how confident that author is.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type                                          | Description                                                   |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| agent     | [Agent](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.Agent`) | The human or software :class:`Agent` that created this match. |
| certainty | [float](`float`)                              | Confidence level in [0, 1]. 1.0 = certain.                    |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> meta = MatchMetadata(
...     agent=Agent(
...         name="analyst_jh",
...         type=AgentType.human,
...         identifier="https://orcid.org/0000-0001",
...     ),
...     certainty=1.0,
... )
```

```python
>>> meta = MatchMetadata(
...     agent=Agent(name="dtw", type=AgentType.software, identifier="v2"),
...     certainty=0.85,
... )
```
